A fast, keyboard-first SQL client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, and ClickHouse (beta).
Open it, run the query, get the answer, get back to work.
A SQL query types itself in data-peek and returns 8 rows in 38 ms, then the view pulls back through the schema
- **Keyboard-first.** `Cmd/Ctrl+K` switches connections and opens tabs, saved queries, and settings. Every shortcut is documented.
Or grab a build from Releases: `.dmg` for macOS (signed and notarised), `.exe` for Windows, and `.AppImage`, `.deb`, or `.tar.gz` for Linux.

It finds tables without a primary key, foreign keys without an index, duplicate, unused, and invalid indexes, bloat, never-vacuumed tables, and nullable foreign keys. These are the same checks as Schema Intel in the app. See `packages/cli`.
npx @data-peek/cli doctor reporting an invalid index, a foreign key without an index, and nullable foreign keys, each with the SQL that fixes it
Watch Mode re-running a query: changed cells flash amber and a new row slides in on a green band
Watch Mode : pin a SELECT and watch cells change live.
An EXPLAIN ANALYZE plan growing into a tree, with the slow sequential scan flagged and the CREATE INDEX that fixes it
Query plans : EXPLAIN ANALYZE as a tree, with the slow node and its fix.
An agent asks to run an UPDATE over MCP and data-peek shows an approval dialog before it runs
MCP server : agents can read freely; every write waits for your approval.
Time Machine scrubbing back to an earlier run of a query and diffing two runs cell by cell
Time Machine : scrub back through past results and diff any two runs.
More clips (command palette, ER diagrams, the AI assistant, inline editing) are on datapeek.dev.
- Multiple tabs and windows, plus cross-tab references: name a tab and query its result from another as `@name`
- Schema Intel diagnostics for unindexed foreign keys, duplicate or unused indexes, missing primary keys, and table bloat, with suggested SQL fixes
- A built-in MCP server (off by default) that exposes your connections to AI agents. Reads are capped and run read-only, and every write needs your approval in the app.
The docs cover every feature in depth.

The source is MIT licensed. The pre-built app is **free for personal use**: side projects, learning, open source, students, educators, non-profits, and solo founders, with every feature included. Using it at a for-profit company of two or more people, or as a freelancer or agency billing clients, needs a Pro licence. Details are in LICENSE.md. To see which devices use your licence, or free a slot after reinstalling your OS, enter your key at datapeek.dev/dashboard.
